reason: Promote to active. The previous 'unverified' status came from a pending merge decision, not from weak or conflicting evidence. Primary official API docs establish the mechanism: parameter and conversation-replay validity is scoped to the model generation. On Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1, tool_choice any/tool returns 400. Earlier models silently drop thinking blocks produced by later models. A prefix-invariance 400 applies to accounts created on or after 2026-08-31, and the docs say later models will enforce it for all accounts. Claude Code v2.1.254 shipped a client-side fix for an Opus 5 instance. On the merge question: P-20260831-DE8D86E9 (active) is triggered by beta-to-GA or SDK-major changes, while this problem is triggered by model selection or fallback under the same API version. The triggers and remedies differ (RMD-BETAGA-001 vs RMD-MODELSCOPEDAPI-001), so keeping them separate is recommended.

evidence.summary: 2026-09-01: tool_choice any/tool returns 400 on Fable 5.1/Mythos 5.1; replacements are strict tool use and structured outputs.
Model-scope check applies to all accounts (silent drop); prefix check enforced for accounts created on or after 2026-08-31, and later models will enforce it for all.
Claude Code fixed Opus 5 requests failing at effort xhigh/max with thinking disabled; client-side, per-model parameter mapping.
official/known-applicable; strict tools instead of tool_choice, append-only history, check input_transformations for dropped blocks.

model_assessment.assessment: Provider docs say enforcement will widen with later models, so the exposure is expected to grow rather than shrink.

remedy_assessment.assessment: Official migration path, current. Distinct from RMD-BETAGA-001.
